checks: Actual installation/retained-ISO startup; shared Save as chooses Downloads, persists exact text and keeps the original source without consuming another window slot
Cancel preserves the document/path, creates no destination and does not change the remembered successful Save location
One click selects without replacing the app document; Enter opens the actual selected validated native text file
The real CPL3 Editor loads the checked multi-page included guide through existing IPC pages without a large kernel stack buffer
Bounded eight-location history, history branching, missing/USB locations, invalid folder name, separate folder creation and automatic text extension use ordinary controls
Existing target requires an explicit replacement; default Enter returns to the picker and Cancel retains the original path
Dirty Open has a separate Save/Discard/Back/Cancel review; Back retains unsaved work and explicit Discard opens the selected original source
Explicit Save and open persists the old modified document before loading the selected new source
Another window remains usable during review; changing and saving the target invalidates the old replacement review, followed by a fresh explicit replacement
Image Viewer uses the common picker to open an actual native BMP while retaining its existing format checks
Archive Manager opens a real ZIP and extracts into a newly created subfolder at the destination chosen through the shared folder dialog
At the eight-window limit keyboard Save as uses its owner without a ninth slot; Alt+F4 cannot bypass it and Cancel returns all window resources
